name: Aztec Treasure Hunt

features.name: Mask wild-collector
features.description: The wild collects money symbols with multipliers up to 50x.

features.name: Treasure chest bonus
features.description: Cash accumulates and pays whenever a wild lands.

review:
Aztec warriors, swords and golden statues, with an Aztec mask that's both wild and collector, carrying multipliers up to 50x. Money icons worth 10x to 1,000x get collected whenever a wild lands with them.

Five or more money symbols trigger free spins, where all cash values pile up in a treasure chest that pays out each time a wild lands. Up to 5,000x; the RTP is slightly below average at 96.03%.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
